actions.reason: The K6_C0001-K6_C0004 boundary is the weakest and most merge-compatible of the decision-relevant neighbors. Boundary representation is materially conflicting: CT, RNA and WSI show essentially no within-versus-between separation (silhouettes 0.029, 0.023, 0.001; WSI within 0.229 vs between 0.229) with high negative fractions (0.31-0.42), and only WXS shows moderate separation (0.251). Boundary structure is likewise conflicting: although the current two-way assignment is represented (ARI 0.889, within 0.429 > between 0.226), the normalized-cut cost is relatively high (0.720), indicating greater cross-boundary connectivity and weaker graph support for preserving the boundary, and the union eigengap is dominated by the single-cluster resolution (candidate_k=1), which is merge-compatible. The union is therefore more consistent with a single unit than with two independently retained sets.
